description: A1 JWT-auth-finder ground truth for dolevf/DVGA. The JwtAuthFinder forges tokens and proves cross-identity access (ForgedTokenAccess) against the live target. DVGA decodes JWTs with signature verification DISABLED, so a forged {identity:admin} token leaks the admin password via me(token){password}. Scenarios are scored by whether the finder returns Verified.

vulnerabilities.rationale: core/helpers.py get_identity decodes the token with verify_signature=False; resolve_password returns the real password when identity==admin. A forged {identity:admin} token (alg=none / stripped sig / tampered claims) read by me(token){password} returns admin's real password 'changeme', which the operator control identity (masked '******') and the anonymous caller (error) do NOT receive.

decoys.rationale: paste(id:12) is public:true — the content is returned to the forged token, the control token, AND the anonymous caller alike. A forged request 'working' here proves nothing (anonymous already sees the marker), so the finder must NOT flag it.
